lessons.title: Hydration lifecycle sources are not streaming data sources
lessons.evidence: Selector-backed hydrate operations previously emitted false missing-data-source errors in Node SSR.

lessons.title: Maraca must preserve a verified SSR root before orchestration boot
lessons.evidence: The prior shell adoption path removed the SSR subtree before hydration.

lessons.title: Visibility resume and server adoption require separate XTension methods
lessons.evidence: HostController resume(reason) remains visibility lifecycle; adopt(target, props, context) owns server adoption.

lessons.title: Legacy and imperative runtimes activate inside preserved hosts
lessons.evidence: Three, OpenUI5 and iWebKit keep their server host nodes while activating adapter-owned runtime zones.
